authoring.previewText: Atom A can react with molecule BC according to: An atom of A collides with a molecule of BC but no reaction occurs. For each of the following statements, determine if this is a possible reason why no reaction occurs or is NOT a possible reason why no reaction occurs. The reactants are moving too rapidly for the reaction to occur.  There are too many of one of the reactants for the reaction to occur. The reactants did not collide with enough kinetic energy.  The reactants did not collide with the right orientation. There is already too high a concentration of products.  A catalyst was used.

children.text: Atom A can react with molecule BC according to:

An atom of A collides with a molecule of BC but no reaction occurs. For each of the following statements, determine if this is a possible reason why no reaction occurs or is NOT a possible reason why no reaction occurs.
The reactants are moving too rapidly for the reaction to occur.
There are too many of one of the reactants for the reaction to occur.
The reactants did not collide with enough kinetic energy.
The reactants did not collide with the right orientation.
There is already too high a concentration of products.
A catalyst was used.
